question: 37 light bulbs were purchased for ₹37, and 19 light bulbs broke in transit. The trader sold the remaining light bulbs at ₹3.90 each. Find his profit.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total remaining bulbs = 37 − 19 = 18.

Total Selling Price (SP) = 18 × ₹3.90 = ₹70.20.

Total Cost Price (CP) = ₹37.

Profit = SP − CP = 70.20 − 37 = 33.20.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹33.20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total light bulbs purchased = 37

Total Cost Price (CP) = ₹37

Number of broken bulbs = 19

Selling Price (SP) per remaining bulb = ₹3.90

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Total Selling Price − Total Cost Price

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 CP = ₹37.00
 Profit = ₹33.20
 
 
 

 Total Selling Price (SP) = 18 × ₹3.90 = ₹70.20
 
 
 Cost of all 37 bulbs
 Extra amount earned

**Calculations:**

⇒ Remaining light bulbs = 37 − 19 = 18

⇒ Total Selling Price (SP) = 18 × 3.90

⇒ Total SP = ₹70.20

⇒ Profit = Total SP − Total CP

⇒ Profit = 70.20 − 37

⇒ Profit = ₹33.20

**∴ The correct answer is ₹33.20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Basic Formula

Profit occurs when Selling Price (SP) > Cost Price (CP). The fundamental formula is: Profit = SP − CP.

Profit Percentage

Profit percentage is always calculated on the base Cost Price (CP) unless specifically mentioned otherwise. Formula: Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

Effective Price of Remaining Items

When certain items are damaged or lost in transit, the overall Cost Price remains unchanged but it must be absorbed entirely by the remaining good items, effectively increasing the Cost Price per unit for the rest.
